rows.coder_note: 'the FinnGen Consortium (including 264 AIH patients and 3,72,273 healthy controls)': endpoint counts with the consortium name and no release number (rule I1).

'the study by Sakaue et al (including 821 AIH cases and 4,84,422 controls)': the dictionary has three Sakaue 2021 rows and the sentence gives no ancestry, cohort set or accession separating them, and the abstract passage has no linked reference entry.

UKB-PPP is attributed to ref 23 (Sun 2023, DOI 10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6), whose source has several dictionary rows; the sentence gives 2940 proteins in 54,219 participants, which matches no single row (no subcohort, ancestry or release-specific N), so rule E is not met. The exome mention in p002 describes the PheWAS portal, not the pQTL data.
